transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I've called us together to review the operating plan for Scene Remix before I give final approval. We need reports from legal, accessibility, and audience-experience staff on any required changes. Let's start with legal — I understand the plan currently permits portrait photographs and video capture, and collects an email address from each participant. Are there any issues we need to address on the capture and data-handling side?

transcript.text: I need to flag two issues from the audience-experience side. I confirmed with the installation vendor after the draft plan was issued that the audio booth's tested workflow supports sessions of exactly 4 minutes — not the 6 minutes currently in the plan. Additionally, the vendor confirmed that the participant-consent system must delete all recordings within exactly 24 hours and must collect no email address from participants. Both of these conflict with the current draft plan, which allows 6-minute sessions and collects an email address from each participant.
